fishing.text: Catching Green Algae, White Algae, Seaweed, River Jelly, Sea Jelly, or Cave Jelly counts towards the 4 fishing achievements (Fisherman, Ol' Mariner, Master Angler, and Mother Catch). Catching Trash does not count. The quest fish for the Extended Family Qi's quest are not required for Master Angler.

polyculture.text: There are exactly 28 crops that must be shipped (15 of each) to earn Polyculture.

monoculture.text: Ship 300 of one crop. Any of the 28 Polyculture crops works, or one of these five:

shipment.text: At least one of every item shown in the Shipping Collection tab of the player menu must be shipped.

helpwanted.text: The weekly quests on the Special Orders board and on Qi's Special Orders board count towards Gofer and A Big Help. Gofer sends 500g from Mayor Lewis the next day, and A Big Help sends 2,500g.

friends.text: Friendship with the player's children also counts towards the friendship achievements.

crafting.text: The Wedding Ring does not count towards the crafting achievements, even in Multiplayer games.
